meta.name: ai-automation-workflows
meta.description: Build automated AI workflows combining multiple models and services. Patterns: batch processing, scheduled tasks, event-driven pipelines, agent loops. Tools: inference.sh CLI, bash scripting, Python SDK, webhook integration. Use for: content automation, data processing, monitoring, scheduled generation. Triggers: ai automation, workflow automation, batch processing, ai pipeline, automated content, scheduled ai, ai cron, ai batch job, automated generation, ai workflow, content at scale, automation script, ai orchestration

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多模型编排自动化工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI模型搭建自动化流水线
copy.tagline_en: Build automated workflows with multiple AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to orchestrate AI models into automated pipelines

howto.what: Claude 会帮你编写 bash 脚本或 Python 代码，通过 inference.sh CLI 调用多个 AI 模型，实现批量处理、定时任务、事件驱动流水线等自动化工作流。
howto.when: 当你提到“AI 自动化”、“工作流自动化”、“批量处理”、“AI 流水线”、“定时 AI”等关键词，或要求自动生成内容、处理数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个每天生成励志图片的脚本。
创建一个内容流水线：先研究主题，再写文章，最后配图。
写一个批量处理多个提示词的脚本。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个循环调用模型的批量处理脚本。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you write bash scripts or Python code to build automated AI workflows using the inference.sh CLI, supporting batch processing, scheduled tasks, event-driven pipelines, and agent loops.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "AI automation", "workflow automation", "batch processing", "AI pipeline", "scheduled AI", or ask to automate content generation or data processing.

say_en.text: Write a script to generate a daily inspirational image.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a cron script that calls an image model daily.

say_en.text: Create a content pipeline: research topic, write article, then generate image.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a bash script that chains multiple AI tasks sequentially.

say_en.text: Write a batch script to process multiple prompts.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a loop-based batch processing script.
